description: ASCII '/' that stays because it is not a fraction or a division sign. Rules are enforced in .github/scripts/check-slash-fractions.mjs. Snippets are an explicit backstop for a match the grammar would otherwise report.

rules.reason: Blog posts and blog pages are excluded (Noam, 18.10.2026).
URLs, site paths, href/src values, and import paths.

Comments, non-string code, and <style>. String literals inside <script>, topicFilms, conceptLoops.ts, and public JavaScript are scanned. A slash in real code, including Math.floor(m / 5) inside an Astro expression, is not a fraction. CSS lengths (8px / 8px), font shorthand (16px/1.5), and aspect-ratio (4 / 3) are not fractions.
Unit rates such as km/h, m/s, and m/s².

Word pairs such as and/or, w/o, and n/a. Hebrew pairs such as יחידות/סימנים are not quotients: the grammar does not treat Hebrew words as a numerator or a denominator. The snippet below records the review of algebraic-expressions-grade-7.json.

Calendar dates: a year (18/10/2026, including the leftover 10/2026), a date word (עודכן, תאריך, ביום), or a day 13–31 with month 1–12 and no math operator (18/10). 1/2 stays a fraction. A 19xx or 20xx denominator with a 1–31 numerator is a year, not a quotient.
Clock and duration text such as 0:00 / 0:19. The colon glues the slash to a timestamp.
Ratios and division already written with a colon are left as they are.
Step labels such as 01 / מתחילים are a number plus a Hebrew title, not a quotient. The kite-area film uses this form (01 / מתחילים מדלתון).
math-tools.json removedOrphans text 3/4 is an editing leftover that is not rendered.
Breadcrumb separators such as בית / כיתה are a lone '/' between Hebrew words, not a numerator over a denominator.
A spaced game score N / 100, such as 7 / 100, is a score out of 100. A tight fraction stays a fraction, including p/100 and 8/100.

snippets.reason: Hebrew pair 'units/signs'. Not a quotient. The grammar already ignores Hebrew words; this entry records the review.
